newsitem.title: QATAR: Qatar share price gains gather pace in the week.
newsitem.headline: Qatar share price gains gather pace in the week.

text.p: Share price gains on Qatar's unofficial market gathered pace in the week to Thursday, bolstered by the return of investors from long summer holidays, brokers said.
The 18-share Commercial Bank of Qatar (CBQ) index moved up one percent to 117.82 points from a previous 116.51 on the back of 12 share price gains. Six were steady.
The biggest mover in the week was market leader Qatar National Bank, which gained 12 riyals, or two percent, to 567.
Commercial Bank of Qatar added three riyals to 326 and Qatar International Islamic Bank moved up half a riyal to 84.50.
Al Ahli Bank of Qatar added four riyals to 208.
Heavyweight Qatar Insurance Co strengthened 10 riyals to 655, Khaleej Insurance edged up a riyal to 285 and Qatar General Insurance added three riyals to 518.
Qatar National Navigation and Transport was a riyal firmer at 685, while Qatar Shipping edged up half a riyal to 46.
Qatar Cinema and Qatar Flour Mills were each three riyals stronger at 172 and 286 respectively.
Qatar National Cement gained a riyal to 284.
